findings.reason: 「同步于 # 秒前」 is a calque: 于 marks a point in time, not an elapsed offset. Replaced with the locale's full-width colon;「上次同步：# 秒前 / # 分钟前」. Number→unit spacing follows relay.asks.duration precedent.
zh-CN style guide forbids a space between Chinese and Latin runs; corpus has 3/3 unspaced prose occurrences of the product name (cli.browser), and this was the only spaced one in all 83 catalogues.
English 'Loading' is 正在加载 in 6 existing strings; 读取 is the locale's word for reading. Changed 正在读取对话…… → 正在加载对话…….
Same app-bar subtitle changed state wording mid-state. Now 重连中…… so the state word is stable into「重连中 · 上次同步：…」; also matches tui.status.model.connecting 连接中…….

忽略 would mean 'ignore and send no reply' (its sense for questions); 关闭 is correct for closing a snackbar. Exception recorded here; glossary/style-guide edit deferred to the owner (shared artefacts outside this locale).

未响应 vs 无响应 is repo-wide drift (relay.asks.error.read_timeout, tui.small.info_panel.not_answering); the chrome pair is internally consistent and a unilateral local change would fragment the repo further. Deferred to glossary owner.
